text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR scre

name: Facet
text: Choose a sticky left sidebar that collapses to a thin tab when unused. It keeps key controls and context always visible without cluttering the main view, matching Manus’ dark theme and Graphify’s central graph focus. The trade-off is slightly less horizontal space for the graph, but liveliness and speed win—users won’t hunt for tools mid-analysis.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky left sidebar still risks users missing updates if they’re deep in the graph—focused users scan the center, not the edge. A full-width top banner (like Graphify’s) keeps critical controls and context always in view without stealing horizontal space from the graph. Settle it with a quick A/B test: track how often users miss sidebar cues versus how often the banner distracts from the graph.
